title: The American Journal of Natural Medicines, Facts
abstract: In the United States, LMM is among the top-selling supplements, with various manufacturers extracting unique bioactive compounds to create varying dosage forms of differing strengths such as capsules, powders, gummies, and liquid extracts in the form of a tincture [[8].](https://www.e3s-conferences.org/articles/e3sconf/abs/2022/22/e3sconf_ri2c2022_02016/e3sconf_ri2c2022_02016.html) Given the growing popularity of LMM as a dietary supplement in the United States, evaluating the existing preclinical and clinical studies by exploring its health benefits is crucial [[9].](https://worldmushroomsociety.com/best-lions-mane-supplements/) A recent review article underscores the importance of strengthening regulations to ensure the quality and safety of adult dietary supplements in the United States, emphasizing the need for greater oversight, and developing product standardization within the industry  Therefore, the objective of this article was to conduct a comprehensive, systematic review (SR) of both animal and human studies to assess the potential health benefits of LMM. The study did emphasize the need for further research and standardization of dietary supplements based on Hericium erinaceus to ensure their effectiveness and safety [[22].](https://www.mdpi.com/1422-0067/24/21/15960) Similarly, another SR published in 2024 highlighted the neuroprotective effects of LMM, showing its potential in preventing neurodegenerative diseases [[24].](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC10675414/)  While some studies suggest a potential for LMM to improve cognitive function, further larger-scale studies are recommended to confirm whether its effect on brain function is statistically significant or not and to better understand the mechanisms behind any detected effects.
